volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP Zotero gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for Chromium to function properly.

image.title: Zotero
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  zotero:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/zotero:latest
    container_name: zotero
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=zotero \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/zotero:latest
